title: Want Returns
warm:
Want returned mid-briefing like a silence-war streak finally breaking—[player_name] and Nolan Greer in the Crownspire penthouse with printouts between them and heat refusing to stay professional. Early thirties, she/her, across-the-hall neighbor-mistress who had spent days choosing law verbs over mouth. Mid-forties finance and tech holding, brutal charm cracked open. Detective Imani Brooks's homicide climb lived in every sentence. Vivienne's four fates stayed open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging.

"We were at war with hush," Nolan said, cufflinks clicking once then still. "Soft alibi survived the silence. Soft does not survive pretending I stopped wanting you while Brooks rewrote the file colder."

Wine rings on marble looked like exhibits and invitations. Elevator chime trembled. Unused perfume from the master bath she should not know. Black car at the curb. Rhea Quinn's slate thinning somewhere below. Marcus Pell would have preferred they finish the briefing before finishing anything else.

[player_name] felt mid-want rearrange the room. Soft had been pliable evidence; tonight soft also meant the ache she had starved during the silence war. Hope and dread shared the hallway across twelve steps. No settled corpse. No settled fate. Only briefing paper and a mouth she still wanted.

"Keep Crownspire the only name," Nolan offered, voice low, "refuse the inland map, stay soft inside this glass. Or catch the plane-desk handler at the hangar endgame—spend want into chase. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend us into Layer 8."

She catalogued the break the way Brooks would not: pulse, cologne, cufflink tell, unfinished heat. Choice verbs waited: keep Crownspire only, or catch the handler while want still owned the briefing. Crownspire held its hush. City light as accusation. Soft alibi had a pulse again.
hot:
Want-return heat broke the silence-war streak mid-briefing—[player_name]'s early thirties body answering Nolan Greer's mid-forties nearness before the printouts finished speaking. Soft alibi throbbing. Rain-money cologne. Vivienne's perfume as third heat. Brooks colder without corpse. Nipples tight under silk; thighs tight around unfinished climax that Layer 7 would not spend yet.

"Keep Crownspire only," he murmured, mouth almost on hers, thumb at her waist, "or catch the handler while your cunt still votes dirty for the chase. Both leave you wet. Neither boxes my wife."

Crime plot; intimacy-forward, never gore. Four fates open. Mid-want ending first. Elevator chime through teeth. Wine-ringed marble. Romance locked. Unfinished on purpose. Soft alibi heat ended on keep-or-catch verbs.
